_comment: Site settings. show_type_pills: false hides the All/Salons/Interviews/... pills in the header for now (Browse takes their place, and search always covers every category). search_unidentified_speakers: false keeps passages whose speaker is not identified out of the search results (the pages still show them). PERMANENT RULE (Colin, 19 Sept 2026): leave it false; unattributed passages are useless as citations. show_search_filters: false hides the Country/Speaker/Type/Year filter dropdowns under the search box (the category pills still filter); true brings them back. canonical_base: the archive's final public address, e.g. https://techspressionism.com/archive/ (empty until it is chosen); when set, every page names its canonical address and a sitemap.xml is written. series_start_years: the year a series began when that is earlier than its first archived recording (the Salons began in September 2020; the first one in the archive is Salon 8 in 2021); it sets the start of the date range shown above each list on the home page. beta_noindex: while true, every page carries a noindex tag so search engines do not list the unfinished archive (set to false at launch). watch_lead_in_seconds: each '▶ watch' link starts this many seconds BEFORE the passage (never before 0:00) so a listener hears the words in context; the printed time and the citation stay exact. pill_lead_in_seconds: the timecode pill above each paragraph starts the inline player this many seconds before that paragraph's first word (raise it if word timing runs late). suggest_url: the page on techspressionism.com that holds the 'Suggest a correction' Gravity Form (leave empty to hide the links). suggest_params: the form's dynamic-population parameter names for the recording (e.g. salon-081), the time in seconds, and the passage text. SEO and AI discovery (see the admin manual 6.18): organization_name / organization_url / youtube_channel_url feed the schema.org markup; license_url and license_name (leave empty until the licence is confirmed) and zenodo_doi appear on the About page, in llms.txt and in the Dataset markup once set; allow_ai_training_crawlers false makes robots.txt disallow the training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended ...). robots.txt is written only when beta_noindex is false.
